titulo_es: Registration and irony in a publication

다음에는 다른 곳에 갈 거예요.es: La próxima vez iré a otro lugar
다음에는 다른 곳에 갈 거예요.en: Next time I'll go somewhere else

texto: In informal publications, the context may make a positive phrase ironic; it checks whether the following confirms or contradicts the initial assessment.
It's very comfortable, yes. I waited an hour, though.
